skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe the basic concepts of virtualization, hypervisor, and virtual machines.
Explain the mechanisms by which hypervisors manage CPU, RAM, storage, and networking resources.
Analyze the operational mechanisms of data center virtualization architecture.
Apply problem-solving techniques to address specific issues within the field of virtualization technologies.
Collaborate effectively with peers to solve specialized problems within a given timeframe.
Demonstrate the ability to independently seek out, gather, and utilize relevant materials for learning.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems related to virtualization technologies.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and participate in class discussions.
Understand and apply CPU scheduling algorithms such as Round Robin and Credit.
Explain memory management techniques including TSP, ballooning, swap, and page compression.
Comprehend the principles of network virtualization including internal and external networks.
Understand the mechanisms of storage virtualization including various types of storage solutions.
